content: Lopez de Prado (Advances in Financial ML): triple-barrier labeling (profit-take/stop-loss/time barriers) matches how trades actually resolve and beats fixed-horizon labels for setup scoring; meta-labeling (primary SMC rule decides direction, ML decides take-or-skip) fits this project exactly; sample uniqueness/overlapping labels inflate CV scores - use purged and embargoed k-fold or walk-forward; probability outputs from boosting are uncalibrated and must pass through isotonic/sigmoid calibration (sklearn CalibratedClassifierCV) before being shown to a user as probabilities.
